meta.title: Fly Slots
meta.description: A cartoon slot machine with a real fly brain beside the reels. Spin for fun or for $FLYAI: provably fair reels, 95% return, and a 166,700-neuron connectome that flinches at every spider.

head.title: Fly Slots
head.sub: Three reels, one payline, and a real fly brain watching every spin. Spiders on the line make it jump. Line up three crowns for 400x.

status.error: the fly is napping; the reels still spin

fun.title: Fun coins
fun.text: Free play: no money, just coins on this device. Same reels and same odds as the real thing.

brain.title: Inside its head
brain.note: Spikes from a real 166,700-neuron fly connectome, running in your browser. Spiders on the line loom at it and it reacts. It never touches the result.

pay.title: Paytable
pay.note: Pays are times your stake, stake included, on the middle line from the left.
pay.rtp: Return to player {rtp}% · a win about 1 spin in {hit}

bet.unreachable: $FLYAI spins are out of reach right now; play for fun still works.
bet.intro: Spin with real $FLYAI from your fly.ai balance, the same balance as Fly Roulette and compute.

bet.how1: Play for fun stays free. Fun coins never touch money; real spins only happen in this mode.
bet.how2: You against the house. The paytable returns 94.95% of stakes over the long run; the rest is the house edge.
bet.how3: Your balance is the same $FLYAI balance Fly Roulette and compute orders use: deposits, winnings and refunds all land in it.
bet.how4: Provably fair. The server commits to its seed before your spin and reveals it after; "Verify this spin" replays the reels from both seeds in your browser. The fly only reacts.

terms.title: Before your first real spin
terms.t1: You spin with real $FLYAI from your balance. You can lose all of it.
terms.t2: The reels are random. The paytable returns 94.95% of stakes over the long run; the rest is the house edge.
terms.t3: The server commits to its seed before each spin and reveals it after, so you can check every spin.
terms.t4: Winnings go to your balance. Withdrawals are sent by hand and can take a day.
terms.t5: Betting may be illegal where you live. It's your responsibility to follow your local laws.
terms.accept: I accept the terms (the same terms as Fly Roulette)
